title: Ankara spatial-evidence readiness

dataset.outer_ring_policy: MultiPolygon outer rings become parts and preserve logical IDs; holes are not exterior facade evidence.

terrain.reason: No terrain raster is present in the active pack.

p1411.note: Height/terrain evidence alone cannot infer the required P.1411 morphology and rooftop relation.

promotion_gate.terrain: Require a declared DTM kind, explicit compatible vertical datum/geoid, checksummed coverage, no-data QA, and deterministic local validation.
promotion_gate.height: Require matched external records with exact/high-confidence overlap, source terms, acquisition/version metadata, and disagreement statistics against OSM.
promotion_gate.impact: Require a non-trivial reduction in fallback-only buildings and a reviewed 432-path transition matrix before any canonical consideration.
promotion_gate.rf: Require a separate before/after canonical artifact proving equations, LOS/NLOS defaults, optimizer objectives, and scenario fingerprints remain unchanged until explicit promotion.

conclusion: Current Ankara readiness is foundation-ready but data-source-blocked: terrain coverage is 0%, absolute roof elevation coverage is 0, and height evidence remains 3.75% observed-or-levels. No new source has been promoted.
